milestone: Private account-only location draft transport foundation
status: Transport/schema implemented; native sending/review/save/relaunch integration NOT implemented; rank 5 and Px incomplete

core.transport: In-memory URLProtocol with real production URLSession/Backend; fixed RPC, workspace/session fencing, cookie/cache policy, redirect refusal and declared/streamed response limits. No real JWT HTTP acceptance.

localSQL.limitation: Pinned PGlite0.5.11 minimal bootstrap; complete production policies separately tested by hosted fixture. No real credentials/network/app data.

performance.name: table_bloat
performance.remediation: Consider running vacuum full (WARNING: incurs downtime) and tweaking autovacuum settings to reduce bloat.

advisors.newPerformanceInfo: location_handoffs_task FK-supporting index is currently unused on the empty table. Retained intentionally for task-delete cascading; not evidence to remove it. Other unrelated advisories left unchanged.

nativeBuild.scope: App and extensions from isolated owned staging. Production Swift matches canonical except existing isolation-only app-group/keychain and test bundle guards. Simulator Debug only for iOS; unsigned Debug only for Mac. No new UI/Store integration to accept.

previousFailures: First focused Core compile used nonexistent Session memberwise initializer; corrected test to actual Session JSON decoder with fake session and noop persistence before passing focused/full suites.

First local harness lacked node_modules; restored pinned npm lock. Fixture lacked temp-table anon grant; changed fixture-only grant. Integral JSON representations failed bigint casts; canonical numeric normalization corrected before deployed migration.

Hosted fixtures first failed production invitation rules (missing auth user context, then direct accepted insertion). Read actual prepare_invitation trigger and changed fixture to owner-invites/member-accepts. Third hosted run passed all28 and rolled back.
privacy: No real task/account/location data used. No existing pins uploaded. Coordinates only in account-private transport payload, never shared tasks/app groups/widgets/backups. Administrator-readable storage, not E2E encryption. Header ticket model contains no name/geometry and is not yet durably stored.
